name: Zobeide
travel_cadence: After six days and seven nights

stones.stone: The white city, well exposed to the moon, with streets wound about themselves as in a skein
stones.mechanic: Coiled three-ring street skein rendered in chalk-moonlight (#eef2f7) and indigo-shadow (#12192c); moonExposure starts at 1.0 and is progressively walled off to <=0.08 as escape turns are sealed.

stones.stone: Men of various nations had an identical dream: a naked woman with long hair running at night through an unknown city, seen from behind, lost after twisting turns
stones.mechanic: Fleeting nocturnal fugitive silhouette seen strictly from behind with streaming golden-hair trace (#e8c266) darting along open skein threads and vanishing around 8 canonical escape turns.

stones.stone: Founders of various nations followed the course of their pursuit and arranged spaces, arcades, stairways, and walls differently at the spot where they lost her so she could not escape again
stones.mechanic: 6 multi-nation founders + 2 new-arrival waves apply arcade_shifted, stairway_reversed, and dead_end_wall traps onto the 8 vanishing corners.

stones.stone: None of them, asleep or awake, ever saw the woman again; streets became their everyday workspace, they forgot the dream, and Zobeide hardened into an ugly trap
stones.mechanic: As enclosureRatio rises 0.0 -> 1.0 (0% -> 100%), dreamMemory decays deterministically 1.0 -> 0.0 (100% -> 0%), fugitiveVisibility drops to 0.0, womanEverCaptured remains strictly false, and nocturnal footstep/hair-wind WebAudio hardens into monotonous workaday masonry drones.

stones.stone: New men arrived from other lands recognizing something of the dream streets, shifting arcades and stairways to leave no avenue of escape while first founders could not understand what drew them to this ugly trap
stones.mechanic: summonNewArrivalWave() adds new dead-end walls and shifted arcades—even past 100% enclosure—incrementing newArrivalWallsCount while dreamMemory stays 0%.

inner_arch: Desire that builds a fortress to capture an elusive vision destroys both the vision and the memory of desiring it: every wall erected to prevent the dreamed woman's escape occludes the moonlight in which she ran, calcifying a luminous nocturnal pursuit into an ugly workaday trap of total amnesia.

anti_trude_vector.medium: Interactive Moonlit Skein Pursuit & Masonry Amnesia Calcifier with Procedural Footstep-to-Drone WebAudio

hard_gates.HG-1: 100% standalone index.html: 0 occurrences of http://, https://, ../, or fetch(; inline JS passes node --check; 0 console/page errors in Chromium at 1280x800 and 390x844.
hard_gates.HG-2: Anti-Trude DOM morphology (J_dom < 0.35, target 0.0000): all 5 chartered custom tags (<zobeide-skein>, <moonlit-pursuit-canvas>, <wall-trap-ledger>, <amnesia-calcifier>, <zobeide-plate-drawer>) present in <body>, zero generic div/section/header/footer/main/nav/aside/article/button/span bloat, 100% .zob-* CSS classes.
hard_gates.HG-3: Causal Calvino invariants: 8 vanishing skein corners & multi-nation founders + new arrivals; pursuing open corners triggers fleeting golden-hair trace from behind that vanishes around turns; blocking corners lowers moonExposure (1.0 -> <=0.08), raises enclosureRatio (0.0 -> 1.0), decays dreamMemory (1.0 -> 0.0 at 100% enclosure), keeps womanEverCaptured === false & womanEverSeenAgain === false, continues allowing new-arrival dead-end walls, and crossfades footsteps to workaday masonry WebAudio.
hard_gates.HG-4: Responsive 1280x800 & 390x844 zero-overflow layout, keyboard & prefers-reduced-motion support, and <zobeide-plate-drawer> [P]/[Z]/[Escape] loading verified Royal Plate Guild map.png (1600x1200), map.svg (1600x1200), and image.png (1600x1000).
